tool_args.rationale: The supply-bullwhip bridge and flux-conservation signatures point to the archived two-layer siphon. The input sweep resolves its curvature, but all five rows use the same sink gradient. The cost-2 probe is the cheapest targeted way to identify the sink response before fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Confirm the archived siphon with a negative square-root branch now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: This branch matches the pilot to rounding precision, but at s_grad = 1 only the product vmax × (1 − rho/2) is identifiable. Using the archived rho range would assume the sink response transfers unchanged.
Its pilot RMSE is 0.0125, below tolerance but worse than the negative square-root branch. The fixed-gradient pilot does not test how either model generalizes across sink gradients.
The pilot is already at the target horizon and closely matches a static flux law. A more expensive trajectory batch is not warranted before resolving the sink response.
